opportunities.point: A consumer durables tailwind can lift earnings without the company doing anything different.
The underlying demand for branded footwear and lifestyle apparel in India remains very much intact.
opportunities.evidence: Demand outlook: "While the first half had its moments of softness, the second half and particularly Q3, carrying into Q4, showed us clearly that the underlying demand for branded footwear and lifestyle apparel in India is very much intact." (concall transcript - 2026-06-01)

opportunities.point: Consumers in Tier 2 and Tier 3 towns are making a clear and steady shift toward organized branded products.
opportunities.evidence: Demand outlook: "The Indian consumer, especially in Tier 2 and Tier 3 towns where the majority of our stores sit, is making a clear and steady shift towards organized branded product." (concall transcript - 2026-06-01)

threats.point: The stock has a history of very deep drawdowns.
A fast-growing debt load raises the stakes on execution.
Peers earn a better ROCE - the competitive position looks weaker.
Peers earn a better ROE - the competitive position looks weaker.
